principle: Data visibility and operation permissions are handled separately.
route_guard_fixes: /permissions is visible to owner and super_admin.
Ordinary users do not see permission management or owner-only modules.
sidebar_fixes: super_admin sees users, organizations, permissions, approvals, and reviews without lock.
viewer sees users and organizations, hides permission management.
No management-only lock is used to hide data-list pages.
page_gate_fixes: Organization list stays visible while create/edit actions are hidden where unauthorized.
User list stays visible while create/disable/reset actions are hidden where unauthorized.
Permission page hides control-plane data for super_admin.
Approval page shows empty content instead of unavailable/sync text when no approvals exist.
async_state_fixes: User and organization page load aborts are retried once to avoid false sync errors during auth/route refresh.
Permission and approval browser validation confirmed final page state after client hydration.
